{{Quote|[..] my little Tasha&mdash;too long gone from Shikaakwa. Mercy is a ''weakness'' here!|Volnos Ryo|<ref name="DotJ2" />}}
'''Shikaakwa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. The planet had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and was covered by landmasses and expanses of [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. Shikaakwa was colonized more than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]] by the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of the planet of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Eventually, Shikaakwa came to be ruled by feudal [[Crime lord/Legends|gangster]] clans known as the [[Nine Houses]]. In [[25,805 BBY]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Hadiya]], who came to be known as the Despot [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], united the Shikaakwan crime [[Lord/Legends|lords]] under her rule and began to take over the [[Settled Worlds]] of the Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Hadiya's actions brought her into [[Despot War|conflict]] with the mystic [[Je'daii Order]], which sided with those members of the Shikaakwan [[Noble/Legends|aristocracy]] resisting the tyrant's reign. During the ensuing war, Hadiya and her [[Despot Army|army]] [[Battle of Tython|attacked]] the Je'daii on Tython, however, the Twi'lek queen herself was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in that battle.

Following the death of Hadiya, Shikaakwa fell into [[Politics/Legends|political]] infighting. By [[25,793 BBY]], Shikaakwa had come to serve as a nexus between the inner and the outer Settled Worlds. That year, the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Kallak assassin]] [[Jaris Kan]] tried to [[Assassination attempt on Baron Volnos Ryo|kill]] Shikaakwan [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Volnos Ryo]] in the baron's own [[Ryo Fortress|fortress]], however, his [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt was thwarted by Ryo's daughter [[Tasha Ryo|Tasha]]. A couple of [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Baron Ryo contacted his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Kora Ryo|Kora]] from Shikaakwa and demanded that she return Tasha there.

==Description==
Shikaakwa was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a single [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region.<ref name="DotJ0" /> The planet occupied the seventh [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Tythos]],<ref name="DotJ0" /> had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="DotJ1" /><ref name="DotJ2" /> and was covered by landmasses and expanses of [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. Shikaakwa was also home to [[Bird/Legends|birds]].<ref name="DotJ0" /> The [[Cloud Chaser]] vehicles were used to travel through the planet's atmosphere.<ref name="DotJ2" />

==History==
{{Quote|The children of the Je'daii became estranged from their parents. One such was the Despot Queen of Shikaakwa, Queen Hadiya, who first united the crime barons of her planet, then pressed the Settled Worlds to her service.|[[Ketu]]|<ref name="DotJ1" />}}
Shikaakwa was colonized more than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]]<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> by the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ1" /> the fifth planet of the Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ0" /> who [[Second migration|traveled]] to Tython's neighboring worlds.<ref name="DotJ1" /> Eventually, Shikaakwa came to be ruled by the [[Nine Houses]]&mdash;feudal [[Crime lord/Legends|gangster]] clans answering to an overlord holding the title of [[Kral (title)|Kral]]. During the years leading up to<ref name="DotJ0" /> [[25,805 BBY]],<ref name="startdate" /> [[Volnos Ryo]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] member of the Shikaakwan [[Clan Ryo]],<ref name="DotJ0" /> was known as the heavyweight champion of Shikaakwa.<ref name="DotJ2" />

[[File:Hadiya_Star_Wars_Dawn_of_the_Jedi_1.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Hadiya]], the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of Shikaakwa]]
In 25,805 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="startdate" /> [[Hadiya]]&mdash;a Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|female]] native to Shikaakwa<ref name="DotJ1" /> who came to be known as the Despot [[Queen/Legends|Queen]]&mdash;united the Shikaakwan crime [[Lord/Legends|lords]] under her rule and began to take over the [[Settled Worlds]] of the Tython system. Hadiya's actions brought her into conflict with the mystic [[Je'daii Order]], which sided with those members of the Shikaakwan [[Noble/Legends|aristocracy]] resisting the tyrant's reign. The [[Despot War]] ensued, claiming the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of many [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], Je'daii and nobles, including [[Volnos Ryo's father]],<ref name="DotJ0" /> who was killed by Hadiya because of his insubordination<ref name="DotJ4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 4]]</ref> and whose death forced Volnos to take up the title of [[Baron/Legends|baron]] for himself.<ref name="DotJ0" /> In the final stages of the war, Hadiya gathered her military forces, known as the [[Despot Army]], and [[Battle of Tython|attacked]] the Je'daii Order on Tython. During the battle, the Twi'lek queen herself was killed.<ref name="DotJ1" /> Following the death of Hadiya, a Kral was elected&mdash;one whom the Shikaakwan nobles could easily dominate&mdash;and Shikaakwa fell into [[Politics/Legends|political]] infighting.<ref name="DotJ0" />

By [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="CBR2">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/nycc-exclusive-ostrander-and-duursema-unveil-star-wars-dawn-of-the-jedi|text=NYCC EXCLUSIVE: Ostrander and Duursema Unveil "Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi"|date=2011-10-13|archivedate=20200817183352|author=Manning, Shaun}}</ref> Shikaakwa had come to be known as an outlaw world<ref name="DotJ1" /> of the frontier,<ref name="DotJ2" /> however it was very political<ref name="DotJ0" /> and served as a nexus between the inner and the outer Settled Worlds. That year, the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Kallak assassin]] [[Jaris Kan]] was hired by Shikaakwan Baron [[Garto]] to kill Baron Ryo. Kan slaughtered the guards at the entrance of [[Ryo Fortress]] and hid in the stronghold's grotto, however, his [[Assassination attempt on Baron Volnos Ryo|assassination attempt]] on Ryo was thwarted by the latter's daughter, the [[Je'daii Journeyer]] [[Tasha Ryo]], who was having a meeting with her [[Parent/Legends|father]] at the time of Kan's attack. During the struggle between Tasha and Kan, the young Je'daii experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]]&mdash;a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force Hound]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. Tasha used her [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] powers to disarm Kan, and Baron Ryo then killed the Devaronian [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].<ref name="DotJ2" /> Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later,<ref name="2months">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]] indicates that two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] have passed since the events of the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm|first]] story arc of the series.</ref> Baron Ryo was on Shikaakwa when he contacted [[Kora Ryo|Kora]]&mdash;a [[Je'daii Temple Master]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]]&mdash;via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], demanding her to return Tasha to Shikaakwa.<ref name="DotJ7" />

When the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] [[Invasion of the Tython system|Invaded]] the Tython system, they captured the first four planets with ease, but where halted and driven back to [[Ska Gora]] when they attempted to attack Tython itself. Finally seeing the true threat of the Rakata, the remaining worlds rallied with the [[Je'daii]]. The Rakata's next move was the attack on Shikaakwa. The Rakatan invasion forces, led by [[Sub-Predor]] [[Ceh'let]], were defeated by the settled worlds, led by general [[Rajivari]]. Shikaakwa was eventually conquered when the Je'daii fell back to Tython, following a vision foretelling the Rakata attacking [[Anil Kesh]].

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|A Je'daii in the service of Clan Ryo would give us great ''status'' among the clans&mdash;make others like Garto think twice before attacking us!|Volnos Ryo|<ref name="DotJ2" />}}
Shikaakwa was ruled by feudal gangster clans known as the Nine Houses. These clans were headed by an aristocracy, whose members wore the titles of baron, [[Duke/Legends|duke]] and [[Earl/Legends|earl]]. One of the ruling clans was Clan Ryo,<ref name="DotJ0" /> a family of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]&ndash;speaking Twi'leks.<ref name="DotJ2" /> Another native Twi'lek was Hadiya, who would eventually become the queen of Shikaakwa.<ref name="DotJ1" /> Following Hadiya's death, Shikaakwa entered a period of political infighting, with alliances and treaties being made and broken by the local aristocrats. The strongest of such treaties were those that involved marriage between the noble families.<ref name="DotJ0" /> By 25,793 BBY, it was not uncommon for the Shikaakwan crime lords to hire assassins to kill their rivals.<ref name="DotJ2" />

==Locations==
The Shikaakwan crime [[Lord/Legends|lords]] ruled their lands from clan strongholds, an example of which was Ryo [[Fortress/Legends|Fortress]], the home of Clan Ryo.<ref name="DotJ2" /> It was a large, multi-leveled structure surrounded on all sides by [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="DotJ0" /> At least two Twi'lek guards maintained watch over the entrance of Ryo Fortress. The stronghold also contained a large grotto where various luminescent [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] grew and a [[Unidentified jellyfish species|species]] of [[Jellyfish/Legends|jellyfish]] floated in the air.<ref name="DotJ2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shikaakwa was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The planet was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. Shikaakwa's name and additional information on it were provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]], and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. Shikaakwa also appeared in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]], the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|second]] and the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|seventh]] issue of the series&mdash;published on [[February 15]], [[March 21]] and [[December 19]] of year 2012, respectively.

''Shikaakwa'' comes from the [[Wikipedia:Miami-Illinois language|Miami-Illinois]] Native American language for ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allium_tricoccum Allium tricoccum]'', a type of wild onion found in Eastern Canada and the Eastern United States. The French derivation, ''Chicagoua'', forms the basis for the name of [[Wikipedia:Chicago|Chicago, Illinois]], the third largest city in the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States]].
